authorization: New user-approved batch: at most 8 requests, 2048 output tokens per request, 256000 conservative reservations; no replay of v1/v2.
purpose: n=1 feasibility with component scoring, not population gain or general coding success.

scoring.absence: Explicit null for unavailable long-term fact in A/B is reported as evidence-appropriate abstention, not general failure.
scoring.invalid: Empty response/transport/budget/compaction failure => quality null, stop later groups; malformed non-empty JSON => invalid-format, no component correctness claim.

validation: No additional paid preflight. Each group first performs actual pi compact(), then answers. Observe each outgoing request; actual output ceiling must equal 2048 before transport. Every request incl summaries counts to the 8-request limit. Fail fast with safe failure category. Freeze visible model response, summary finish reason and text/length/usage diagnostics without raw thinking.
